content: Running time increases as the number of items grows (e.g., sorting \(6 \times 10^9\) elements takes far longer than sorting 6). To analyze this, we express time as a function of input size. We usually focus on **upper bounds** on running time because they provide a practical guarantee to users (e.g., “it won’t take more than 3 seconds”), whereas lower bounds don’t ensure it won’t take much longer.
